title: Recovery 2.3 - the clip on U8: reading the LaunchPad's flash
caption: RESET held for the whole read. The clip on U8 with its pin-1 lead at the dot. CS, SO, SI, SCLK and GND to the 3.3 V reader; the clip's VCC lead stays off (the LaunchPad's own USB powers the flash).

callouts.label: Serial flash (MX25R3235F), SOIC-8
callouts.note: 'U8' printed right of it. The marking runs sideways and is only partly legible ('MXIC', '25R3235F'; the lot line is not readable), so the part is by the LaunchPad's design. Standard SPI NOR pinout, pins 1-4 down the left side, 5-8 up the right.

callouts.label: Pin-1 dot
callouts.note: A round laser dot in the body's top-left corner, beside the top-left leg; read on a 4x zoom of the photo. No bevel is visible on this side, so the dot alone marks pin 1.

callouts.label: pin 1, CS#
callouts.note: The leg at the dot. The clip's pin-1 lead (its marked wire) goes here. To the reader's CS.

callouts.label: pin 2, SO
callouts.note: Flash data out: to the reader's MISO.

callouts.label: pin 3, WP#
callouts.note: Not wired to the reader; the clip's lead stays loose. How the LaunchPad ties it: its schematic not checked (unverified).

callouts.label: pin 4, GND
callouts.note: To the reader's GND (the common ground with the LaunchPad).

callouts.label: pin 5, SI
callouts.note: Flash data in: from the reader's MOSI. Across from pin 4.

callouts.label: pin 7, HOLD#
callouts.note: Not wired to the reader; the clip's lead stays loose. How the LaunchPad ties it: its schematic not checked (unverified).

callouts.label: pin 8, VCC
callouts.note: Across from pin 1. The clip's VCC lead stays OFF: the LaunchPad's USB powers the flash, a second supply would back-feed the board.
